description: This source file defines the PHP class 'CodeBuildClient' in the 'Aws\CodeBuild' namespace. The class extends 'AwsClient' and is used to interact with the AWS CodeBuild service. It includes docblock annotations for various methods related to AWS CodeBuild operations, specifying both synchronous and asynchronous versions.
